Job Title: GenAI Engineer (511 Years) – Immediate Joiners Preferred

Experience: 5 – 11 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced GenAI Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agent Frameworks, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol). The ideal candidate will design and implement intelligent, scalable AI systems leveraging LLMs, multi-agent workflows, and contextual reasoning.

Candidates who can join immediately or within short notice periods are highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop GenAI-powered applications using modern LLM ecosystems
Build and optimize RAG pipelines for context-aware AI solutions
Develop Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
Implement and manage multi-agent orchestration and workflows
Utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP) for advanced prompt and context management
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and databases
Fine-tune prompts and evaluate model performance (accuracy, latency, cost)
Ensure security, scalability, and reliability of AI solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineering, product, and DevOps
Stay updated on emerging GenAI tools, frameworks, and best practices

Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong experience in Generative AI / LLM-based application development
Hands-on experience with RAG architectures (vector DBs like FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
Expertise in Agent Frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.)
Experience building Agentic AI systems / multi-agent orchestration
Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or equivalent context-management approaches
Strong programming skills in Python
Experience working with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar LLM APIs
Familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluation techniques
Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with fine-tuning / embedding models
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
Knowledge of ML Ops / LLM Ops tools
Experience with streaming pipelines and real-time AI systems
Understanding of data privacy and AI governance
